title: Harry Baker 2K Sailing Regatta
summary: Annual short coastal regatta off the Sorrento foreshore, hosted by Sorrento Sailing Couta Boat Club. Primarily a club entry, spectators welcome from the pier.
accessibilityNotes: Waterfront venue; limited accessibility on vessels
nearbyAttractions: Sorrento Village; Continental Hotel; Back Beach
suggestedItineraryPairing: Combine with lunch at Hotel Sorrento; walk to Sorrento Pier
editorVerdict: A members' race more than a public event, but worth a pier walk if you're in Sorrento for lunch anyway.
editorNote:
The Harry Baker 2K is a short-coastal regatta hosted by Sorrento Sailing Couta Boat Club, part of the club's active autumn racing calendar. Entry is primarily for club members and visiting sailors with the right class boat.

Who it's for: sailors with an SSCBC connection, and locals who like watching a fleet of Couta Boats and dinghies go around the marks. For everyone else, pair it with a Hotel Sorrento lunch and a walk down to the pier.

Check the SSCBC site for sailing instructions and the day's start time closer to the date, the format and distance can shift year to year.
